## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves. Link related issues with `Closes #123`.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor with no behavior change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or CI

## How it was tested

Describe manual steps (browser, engine mode, rules used) and any new unit tests.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes with no type errors
- [ ] Logic in `src/core` has unit tests covering the change
- [ ] Everything still runs client-side; no backend or external service was introduced
- [ ] No emoji in code, UI text or documentation
- [ ] Comments explain decisions or algorithms, not what the next line does
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for UI changes (light and dark theme)
